import json
import os
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import Patch
from matplotlib.lines import Line2D

# Load data
with open('/app/benchmark/source_data.json', 'r') as f:
    data = json.load(f)

fed = pd.DataFrame(data['fed_funds_rate']['data'])
debt = pd.DataFrame(data['external_debt_to_gdp']['data'])
dep = pd.DataFrame(data['currency_depreciation']['data'])
ratings = pd.DataFrame(data['sovereign_rating_changes']['data'])

# Focus comparison on 2024 levels (latest snapshot in dataset)
debt_2024 = debt[debt['year'] == 2024][['country', 'debt_gdp_pct']]
dep_2024 = dep[dep['year'] == 2024][['country', 'depreciation_pct']]
merged = debt_2024.merge(dep_2024, on='country', how='inner')

# Downgrade/default counts during steep Fed hike phase (2022Q2-2023Q3)
steep_start = pd.Timestamp('2022-04-01')
steep_end = pd.Timestamp('2023-09-30')
ratings['date_ts'] = pd.to_datetime(ratings['date'] + '-01')
ratings['is_negative'] = ratings['action'].isin(['downgrade', 'default'])
neg_counts = (
    ratings[(ratings['is_negative']) & (ratings['date_ts'] >= steep_start) & (ratings['date_ts'] <= steep_end)]
    .groupby('country')
    .size()
    .rename('neg_actions_hike_phase')
    .reset_index()
)
merged = merged.merge(neg_counts, on='country', how='left')
merged['neg_actions_hike_phase'] = merged['neg_actions_hike_phase'].fillna(0)

# Marker sizes by negative rating actions
merged['size'] = 90 + merged['neg_actions_hike_phase'] * 140

# Editorial palette
base_color = '#1f4e79'
accent_color = '#b22222'
neutral = '#5a5a5a'
light_grid = '#d9d9d9'

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(12.5, 8.2), dpi=160)
fig.patch.set_facecolor('white')
ax.set_facecolor('white')

# Scatter: vulnerability spectrum
sc = ax.scatter(
    merged['debt_gdp_pct'],
    merged['depreciation_pct'],
    s=merged['size'],
    c=merged['neg_actions_hike_phase'],
    cmap='Reds',
    alpha=0.85,
    edgecolor='#222222',
    linewidth=0.8,
    zorder=3,
)

# Country labels
for _, r in merged.iterrows():
    ax.annotate(
        r['country'],
        (r['debt_gdp_pct'], r['depreciation_pct']),
        xytext=(6, 5),
        textcoords='offset points',
        fontsize=9,
        color='#1a1a1a',
    )

# Reference trendline
coef = pd.Series(merged['depreciation_pct']).corr(pd.Series(merged['debt_gdp_pct']))
m, b = pd.np.polyfit(merged['debt_gdp_pct'], merged['depreciation_pct'], 1)
x_vals = pd.Series([merged['debt_gdp_pct'].min()-2, merged['debt_gdp_pct'].max()+2])
ax.plot(x_vals, m*x_vals + b, color=base_color, linestyle='--', linewidth=1.8, zorder=2)

# Axes styling
ax.set_xlabel('External debt (% of GDP, 2024)', fontsize=11)
ax.set_ylabel('Currency depreciation vs USD (% from Jan 2021 baseline to 2024)', fontsize=11)
ax.grid(True, color=light_grid, linewidth=0.8, alpha=0.8)
ax.set_axisbelow(True)

# Inset: Fed funds trajectory timeline reference
inset = fig.add_axes([0.12, 0.69, 0.36, 0.21])
q_order = fed['date'].tolist()
inset.plot(range(len(fed)), fed['rate_pct'], color=base_color, linewidth=2.2)
inset.scatter(range(len(fed)), fed['rate_pct'], color=base_color, s=18)

# Highlight steep hike phase
start_idx = q_order.index('2022-Q2')
end_idx = q_order.index('2023-Q3')
inset.axvspan(start_idx-0.2, end_idx+0.2, color=accent_color, alpha=0.13)
inset.text((start_idx+end_idx)/2, fed['rate_pct'].max()+0.12, 'Steep hike phase',
           ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=8.5, color=accent_color)

inset.set_title('Fed Funds Rate Reference Timeline (Quarterly, %)', fontsize=9.5, pad=4)
inset.set_ylabel('Rate (%)', fontsize=8.5)
inset.set_xticks([0, 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12])
inset.set_xticklabels([q_order[i] for i in [0, 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12]], fontsize=7.5)
inset.tick_params(axis='y', labelsize=7.5)
inset.grid(True, color=light_grid, linewidth=0.7, alpha=0.75)

# Title and subtitle
ax.set_title(
    'Emerging-Market Vulnerability vs. Fed Tightening (2021–2024)\n'
    'Higher external debt aligns with larger FX depreciation; bubble size/color encode downgrade/default clustering during steep hikes',
    fontsize=13,
    loc='left',
    pad=16,
)

# Legends
size_legend_vals = [0, 1, 2]
size_handles = [
    plt.scatter([], [], s=90 + v * 140, facecolor='#f28e8c', edgecolor='#222222', alpha=0.65)
    for v in size_legend_vals
]
size_labels = [f'{v} negative rating actions (2022Q2–2023Q3)' for v in size_legend_vals]

leg1 = ax.legend(size_handles, size_labels, title='Sovereign rating actions',
                 loc='upper left', bbox_to_anchor=(0.01, 0.985),
                 frameon=True, fontsize=8.5, title_fontsize=9)
ax.add_artist(leg1)

line_handle = Line2D([0], [0], color=base_color, linestyle='--', linewidth=1.8,
                     label=f'Linear fit (corr={coef:.2f})')
ax.legend(handles=[line_handle], loc='lower right', frameon=True, fontsize=8.5)

# Limits and layout
ax.set_xlim(30, max(75, merged['debt_gdp_pct'].max() + 3))
ax.set_ylim(10, max(80, merged['depreciation_pct'].max() + 6))

# Footnote
fig.text(
    0.01, 0.012,
    'Source: source_data.json (external_debt_to_gdp, currency_depreciation, fed_funds_rate, sovereign_rating_changes). '\
    'Depreciation is cumulative from Jan 2021 baseline.',
    fontsize=8,
    color=neutral,
)

os.makedirs('/app/output', exist_ok=True)
plt.savefig('/app/output/result.png', bbox_inches='tight')
print('Saved /app/output/result.png')

import json
import os
from datetime import datetime
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.lines import Line2D

with open('/app/benchmark/source_data.json', 'r') as f:
    data = json.load(f)

fed = data['fed_funds_rate']['data']
debt = data['external_debt_to_gdp']['data']
dep = data['currency_depreciation']['data']
ratings = data['sovereign_rating_changes']['data']

# Latest snapshot (2024)
debt_2024 = {row['country']: row['debt_gdp_pct'] for row in debt if row['year'] == 2024}
dep_2024 = {row['country']: row['depreciation_pct'] for row in dep if row['year'] == 2024}

countries = sorted(set(debt_2024.keys()) & set(dep_2024.keys()))

# Negative rating actions during steep Fed hike phase (2022-Q2 to 2023-Q3)
start = datetime(2022, 4, 1)
end = datetime(2023, 9, 30)
neg_counts = {c: 0 for c in countries}
for row in ratings:
    dt = datetime.strptime(row['date'] + '-01', '%Y-%m-%d')
    if start <= dt <= end and row['action'] in ('downgrade', 'default') and row['country'] in neg_counts:
        neg_counts[row['country']] += 1

x = np.array([debt_2024[c] for c in countries], dtype=float)
y = np.array([dep_2024[c] for c in countries], dtype=float)
neg = np.array([neg_counts[c] for c in countries], dtype=float)
sizes = 90 + neg * 140

# Correlation and fit
corr = np.corrcoef(x, y)[0, 1]
m, b = np.polyfit(x, y, 1)

# Palette
base = '#1f4e79'
accent = '#b22222'
grid = '#d9d9d9'
neutral = '#5a5a5a'

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(12.5, 8.2), dpi=160)

sc = ax.scatter(
    x, y,
    s=sizes,
    c=neg,
    cmap='Reds',
    alpha=0.85,
    edgecolor='#222222',
    linewidth=0.8,
    zorder=3,
)

for i, c in enumerate(countries):
    ax.annotate(c, (x[i], y[i]), xytext=(6, 5), textcoords='offset points', fontsize=9, color='#1a1a1a')

xline = np.linspace(min(x)-2, max(x)+2, 100)
ax.plot(xline, m*xline + b, color=base, linestyle='--', linewidth=1.8, zorder=2)

ax.set_xlabel('External debt (% of GDP, 2024)', fontsize=11)
ax.set_ylabel('Currency depreciation vs USD (% from Jan 2021 baseline to 2024)', fontsize=11)
ax.grid(True, color=grid, linewidth=0.8, alpha=0.8)
ax.set_axisbelow(True)

# Inset Fed timeline
inset = fig.add_axes([0.12, 0.69, 0.36, 0.21])
q = [r['date'] for r in fed]
r = [r['rate_pct'] for r in fed]
idx = list(range(len(q)))
inset.plot(idx, r, color=base, linewidth=2.2)
inset.scatter(idx, r, color=base, s=18)
start_idx = q.index('2022-Q2')
end_idx = q.index('2023-Q3')
inset.axvspan(start_idx-0.2, end_idx+0.2, color=accent, alpha=0.13)
inset.text((start_idx+end_idx)/2, max(r)+0.12, 'Steep hike phase', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=8.5, color=accent)
inset.set_title('Fed Funds Rate Reference Timeline (Quarterly, %)', fontsize=9.5, pad=4)
inset.set_ylabel('Rate (%)', fontsize=8.5)
inset.set_xticks([0, 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12])
inset.set_xticklabels([q[i] for i in [0, 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12]], fontsize=7.5)
inset.tick_params(axis='y', labelsize=7.5)
inset.grid(True, color=grid, linewidth=0.7, alpha=0.75)

ax.set_title(
    'Emerging-Market Vulnerability vs. Fed Tightening (2021–2024)\n'
    'Higher external debt aligns with larger FX depreciation; bubble size/color encode downgrade/default clustering during steep hikes',
    fontsize=13,
    loc='left',
    pad=16,
)

# Legends
size_vals = [0, 1, 2]
size_handles = [plt.scatter([], [], s=90 + v * 140, facecolor='#f28e8c', edgecolor='#222222', alpha=0.65) for v in size_vals]
size_labels = [f'{v} negative rating actions (2022Q2–2023Q3)' for v in size_vals]
leg1 = ax.legend(size_handles, size_labels, title='Sovereign rating actions',
                 loc='upper left', bbox_to_anchor=(0.01, 0.985),
                 frameon=True, fontsize=8.5, title_fontsize=9)
ax.add_artist(leg1)
line_handle = Line2D([0], [0], color=base, linestyle='--', linewidth=1.8, label=f'Linear fit (corr={corr:.2f})')
ax.legend(handles=[line_handle], loc='lower right', frameon=True, fontsize=8.5)

ax.set_xlim(30, max(75, max(x) + 3))
ax.set_ylim(10, max(80, max(y) + 6))

fig.text(0.01, 0.012,
         'Source: source_data.json (external_debt_to_gdp, currency_depreciation, fed_funds_rate, sovereign_rating_changes). '\
         'Depreciation is cumulative from Jan 2021 baseline.',
         fontsize=8, color=neutral)

os.makedirs('/app/output', exist_ok=True)
plt.savefig('/app/output/result.png', bbox_inches='tight')
